007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.credential;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Credential;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.CredentialConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for creating a database credential used by Select AI.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
021 * {@link CredentialConfig}, obtain a {@link Credential} object from
022 * {@link SelectAI#credential(CredentialConfig)}, call
023 * {@link Credential#create()}, and print whether the create operation
024 * succeeded.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating the credential identified
027 * by {@code SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME}. Verify the credential name and secret
028 * values before running it.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * <p>For username/password credentials, set:</p>
039 * <ul>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD (optional)</li>
042 * </ul>
043 *
044 * <p>If {@code SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME} is not set, this sample creates
045 * an OCI signing-key credential and requires:</p>
046 * <ul>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_USER_OCID</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_TENANCY_OCID</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_PRIVATE_KEY</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_FINGERPRINT</li>
051 * </ul>
052 *
053 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
054 * <pre>{@code
055 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
059 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
060 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
061 * <pre>{@code
062 * mvn clean install
063 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
064 * }</pre>
065 *
066 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
067 * <pre>{@code
068 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
069 *   -d samples/out \
070 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/credential/CreateCredentialSample.java
071 * }</pre>
072 *
073 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
074 * <pre>{@code
075 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
076 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.credential.CreateCredentialSample
077 * }</pre>
078 *
079 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
080 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
081 * and diagnostics.</p>
082 */
083public final class CreateCredentialSample {
084    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateCredentialSample.class);
085
086    private CreateCredentialSample() {
087    }
088
089    public static void main(String[] args) {
090        String credentialName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME");
091
092        try {
093            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
094            Credential credential = selectAI.credential(buildCredentialConfig(credentialName));
095            boolean created = credential.create();
096
097            System.out.printf("Create credential '%s' completed: %s%n", credentialName, created);
098        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
099            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI credential '{}'.", credentialName, e);
100        }
101    }
102
103    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
104        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
105                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
106                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
107                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
108                .build();
109
110        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
111    }
112
113    private static CredentialConfig buildCredentialConfig(String credentialName) {
114        CredentialConfig.Builder builder = CredentialConfig.builder(credentialName);
115        String credentialUsername = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME");
116        if (credentialUsername != null) {
117            return builder
118                    .username(credentialUsername)
119                    .password(optionalEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD"))
120                    .build();
121        }
122        return builder
123                .userOcid(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_USER_OCID"))
124                .tenancyOcid(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_TENANCY_OCID"))
125                .privateKey(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PRIVATE_KEY"))
126                .fingerprint(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_FINGERPRINT"))
127                .build();
128    }
129
130    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
131        String value = System.getenv(name);
132        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
133            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
134        }
135        return value;
136    }
137
138    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
139        String value = System.getenv(name);
140        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
141    }
142
143}
